title: 10 Minutes Powerful Morning Prayer Before You Start Your Day | Apostle Joshua Selman
paragraphs: Beloved, hear me this morning. Every day begins with an instruction from the spirit realm. Every morning carries a verdict, a prophecy, a decree. If you do not rise early to legislate, you may find yourself living under what others have spoken. Job 38:12-13 says, "Hast thou commanded the morning since thy days, and caused the daypring to know his place, that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, that the wicked might be shaken out of it."

This means every morning must be commanded, every day must be decreed into alignment with the purposes of God. If you do not command the morning, the wicked will hijack it. But if you rise in prayer, you compel creation to favor you. You scatter the counsel of the wicked and you position yourself for victory. This is why Psalm 53 says, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Mornings are gates, and gates must be opened with keys.

Prayer is the key that opens the gates of the morning. Praise is the voice that compels the day to bow. Declarations are the skepter with which you legislate over time. Hear me. A man who masters the morning cannot be defeated through the day. Therefore, as you rise this morning, you are not rising casually. You are rising with power. You are rising with decrees. You are rising with the blood of Jesus as your weapon. You are rising to scatter every agenda of darkness.

Lift your voice and declare, "By the blood of Jesus, I command this morning to favor me. By the word of the Lord, I scatter every evil plan against my day. By the fire of God, I decree that every arrow fired against me today backfires. By divine authority, I command the heavens to release my portion. I decree and declare according to Lamentations 3:23, they are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness. The mercies of God are new this morning.

Fresh mercy for your family, fresh mercy for your work, fresh mercy for your health, fresh mercy for your destiny. I decree and declare according to Psalm 30:5, weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. Every night season of pain ends now. This morning announces your joy. This morning brings your testimony. This morning shifts your story. I decree and declare according to Isaiah 50:40, he wakenth morning by morning. He wakenth mine ear to hear as the lannet. This morning your ears are open.

You will hear instructions. You will not walk in confusion. You will not Psalm 121:6 says, "The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night. I prophesy the sun will favor you today. The earth will yield its increase for you. Creation will align with your destiny. The elements of the day will cooperate with your assignment. Thus sayeth the spirit of God, this day will not swallow you. This morning will not conspire against you. The hours ahead will serve you. The gates of time will open for you.

No evil will befall you. No plague will come near your dwelling. Pray violently again. By the blood of Jesus, I silence every tongue rising against me this morning. By the fire of God, I scatter every witchcraft meeting held against me at midnight. By divine authority, I decree my name will not be mentioned for evil today. By the covenant of Christ, I declare my feet are ordered into blessing.

Psalm 91:11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways, angels are already moving on your behalf, angels to preserve you, angels to fight for you, angels to deliver your portion, angels to secure your journey. I prophesy over you. Your steps are ordered. Your paths are preserved. Your way is made straight. You will not walk into traps. You will not fall into snares. You will not stumble into losses. Declare with faith, "This morning I rise in power.

This day I walk in victory. This morning I decree open doors. This day I decree preservation. This morning I frustrate the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. Beloved, this morning prayer is your shield. This is how you legislate. You are commanding light to shine. You are commanding the heavens to favor you. You are scattering every plan of darkness. From this morning, I decree your family is preserved. Your business is favored, your health.

Beloved, the morning is not just a time. It is a gate. Psalm 24:7 declares, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lift up ye everlasting doors, and the king of glory shall come in." This means every day has gates, and if you do not command them, evil spirits will. But when you rise in the morning and decree, you take hold of the gates and you enthrone the king of glory over your day. This morning I declare your gates are secured. Your doors are preserved. Your hours are covered.

No enchantment will find expression in your day. over your finances. I decree Deuteronomy 28:12, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand. Today the heavens open over your finances. The works of your hands are blessed. Every cause of empty labor is broken. Every spirit of devourer is rebuked. Every plan of loss is scattered. I decree and declare today you will not lack. Today you will not beg.

Today resources find you. Today destiny helpers locate you over your health. I decree. Exodus 23:25. And ye shall serve the Lord your God, and he shall bless thy bread and thy water, and I will take sickness away from the midst of thee. Every arrow of sickness fired into your day, return to sender. Every plan of infirmity against your body, scatter by fire today. Strength is your portion today. Vitality is your portion today. No disease will overpower you over your family.

I decree Isaiah 54:13, "And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord, and great shall be the peace of thy children. Your household is preserved. Your children are secured. Peace reigns in your home. No weapon of confusion will prosper. No arrow of division will succeed. No tragedy will enter your house over your restoration. I decree Zechariah 9:12. Turn you to the stronghold, ye prisoners of hope. Even today do I declare that I will render double unto thee.

Today is your day of double, double favor, double blessing, double restoration. Everything stolen by darkness is returned. Everything hijacked by witchcraft is released. Everything buried in the night is resurrected by the blood of Jesus. Now engage warfare. By the blood of Jesus, I frustrate every conspiracy against my destiny today. By the fire of God, I scatter every satanic agenda programmed into the hours of this morning by divine authority according to Job 22:28.

Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways. Therefore I decree today my path shines. Today my way prospers. Today my light cannot be hidden. Today my destiny advances. According to Psalm 91:7, a thousand shall fall at thy side and 10,000 at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. Every arrow targeted at you today falls to the ground. Every agenda of the wicked collapses. Every plan of the enemy is frustrated. Prophetic utterance.

I hear in my spirit, today is the day someone will step into long awaited favor. Today is the day someone's tears will be turned into testimony. Today is the day someone's prayer will be answered speedily. Thus sayaeth the spirit of God, the gates of this morning are open unto you, and nothing shall shut them. Pray with intensity. By the blood of Jesus, I cover my journey today. By the fire of God, I scatter every ambush on my path. By divine authority, I decree no accident, no evil report, no sudden tragedy.

By the covenant of Christ, I declare my steps are ordered. Psalm 37:23 says, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he delighted in his way. Today your steps are ordered. Today your paths are preserved. Today your going out and your coming in are blessed." Lift your voice in worship. Lord, you are my shield this morning. You are my covering. You are my glory. You are the lifter of my head. You are the one who crowns my day with goodness. Now seal with decrees by the blood of Jesus.
This morning is blessed by the word of God. This day is secured by the fire of the spirit. Every evil plan is cancelled by divine authority
practice: Set aside ten quiet minutes. Give the first to gratitude and the last to listening. In between, speak plainly about the people and decisions on your mind.
